news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹27.42 (vs ₹10.85 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹27.42 (up from ₹10.85 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹4.01b (up 65% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹287.4m (up 162% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.2% (up from 4.5% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 47% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 52% per year.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.5x net interest cover). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.86 (vs ₹3.34 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.86 (up from ₹3.34 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.02b (up 65% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹50.1m (up 49% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.9% (down from 5.5% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 49% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 41% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
